messages:
ashley: Quick sync — we need to pick two things for Q3 OKR: retention targets for traces/logs, and a tracing sampling strategy that keeps cost in check without breaking error-analysis work. thoughts?

mike: leaning on customer asks — Acme and BetaCorp both asked for ~30d trace retention for billing flows. can we support per-route overrides instead of org-wide defaults?

sophia: +1 for route-level retention. also think adaptive sampling is key: high-error routes stay at 100% sampling, healthy routes down to 1-5%.

raj: numbers to watch: our last run showed 30d traces ~ 3x storage vs 7d. prefix caching for hot spans reduced token egress ~20%. need to quantify for major models.

eva: propose launch criteria for MVP: (1) per-route retention UI in Console, (2) trace-sampling policy editor (presets + custom), (3) a basic cost estimator in Console, (4) regression alert hooks wired to current eval sets, (5) docs + migration guide. any missing items?

mike: backend blocker: TTL/index changes for trace storage need schema migration. estimate ~2 sprints + one small migration window. also need migration plan for large orgs.

ashley: can we ship UI and installer behind a server-side feature-flag so early customers can opt in while backend work finishes?

sophia: yes. UI can surface a warning: "Server-side retention not enabled — changes saved locally until backend is ready". For sampling presets: Dev (100%), Default (10%), Low (1%), plus Custom. show estimated monthly cost delta inline.

raj: requirement: console cost-estimator must show delta per-ORG and per-route, and be within 10% of infra billing for rollups. I'll validate against last quarter's invoices.

eva: UX ask from sales: please include microcopy "what you'll save" and an explainers panel. marketing wants a concise one-pager for the Dedicated pitch.

ashley: tiny config example we can show in docs:
```
route: /payments/*
retention_days: 30
sampling: 100%
```
